sinopsis.es: Una mujer piensa en voz alta sobre quién es y sobre su papel de madre. En el recuento aparecen su amor, lo que ha sacrificado por sus hijos y los muchos recuerdos felices que guarda de ellos.
sinopsis.en: The film begins with a woman reflecting about her role as a person and as a mother. Her love and the sacrifices she has made for her children are evident and she has many happy memories of her time spent with them.
